text: Gr. house of the kingdome of his father.
Or, officers. gouernment, chiefemen, or men in aythoritie.
Or, laboured to defend his high Priesthood.
Or, fledde from him to the enemie. , Or, inuade the countrey.
Or, were growen very strong. , Gr. to abide them.
Gr. meet Iudas in battell. , Or, Carphasalama.
